definitions.explanation: The upcoming period, version, or successor in a sequence, especially for positions, products, or plans.

examples.japanese: {次期|じき}⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧だろう。
examples.english: I wonder who the next president will be.

examples.japanese: {次期|じき}⟦モデル→モデル：05112_moderu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{次期|じき}⟦{大統領|だいとうりょう}→大統領：03418_daitouryou⟧⟦{候補|こうほ}→候補：02804_kouho⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{挙|あ}がっている→挙がる：30433_agaru⟧。
examples.english: His name is being mentioned as a candidate for the next president.

notes:
Functions as a prefix-like modifier placed before nouns to indicate the next one in a sequence. Very common in news and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {次期|じき}⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧ — the next company president
- {次期|じき}⟦{大統領|だいとうりょう}→大統領：03418_daitouryou⟧ — the next president
- {次期|じき}⟦モデル→モデル：05112_moderu⟧ — the next model/version
- {次期|じき}⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧ — the next plan
- {次期|じき}⟦{候補|こうほ}→候補：02804_kouho⟧ — next-in-line candidate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧ — time period, season (same pronunciation, different meaning)
- ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ — next (everyday, general purpose)
- {来期|らいき} — next term/period (specifically about fiscal or academic terms)

USAGE:
{次期|じき} implies a formal succession or planned replacement. Use ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ for everyday "next" and {次期|じき} when discussing successors to positions, product lines, or official plans.
